responsibility: Defines the private compatibility types, XCOFF and big-archive record layouts, constants, and lightweight ldfcn-style API declarations that support collect2’s AIX cross-object scanning. It provides the internal LDFILE and SYMENT representations, magic values, symbol and file-header formats, and CROSS_AIX_SUPPORT configuration gate that allow collect2-aix.cc to emulate the subset of AIX linker-file access routines needed by collect2 without depending on host system AIX headers.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition header for collect2's AIX cross-support pair: it declares CROSS_AIX_SUPPORT, the XCOFF and big-archive layouts, internal LDFILE/SYMENT types, constants, and ldfcn-style prototypes. Unlike gcc/collect2-aix.cc, it provides the data model and API surface that the implementation uses, not the parsing logic itself.
